decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler is core to the air-cooled heat exchange portfolio and supports the efficiency strategy at low incremental cost.
Air cooled condensers remain a standard offering for power and refrigeration customers and use the firm's established manufacturing base.
Although it overlaps with Product B, the variant serves different applications, and an expanding firm is likely to keep it rather than consolidate now.
The customized industrial air cooler line directly reflects the firm's integrated, customized solutions approach across many industries.
Tube end repair inserts support the service and spare parts business, though the withdrawal of the related tube liner suggests some risk for repair products.
